extracted.intended_audience: U.S. consumers considering Hulu / Disney+ / ESPN bundle subscriptions (including ad-supported/ad-free plans and Live TV)
extracted.subtask_description: Information and rules for purchasing and using Hulu, Disney+, and ESPN bundle plans (including Live TV and add‑ons), covering eligibility, availability, pricing, device requirements, and promotional terms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligibility (residency and age)
rubrics_metrics.description: U.S. residents, 18+ only. Offer valid for eligible subscribers only.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Available for U.S. residents, 18+ only. Offer valid for eligible subscribers only; new and eligible returning subscribers (who have not been Hulu subscribers in the past 1 month) only; select third party billed subscribers and current Disney+ and/or ESPN+ subscribers are not eligible.

rubrics_metrics.name: Geographic availability of Live TV and channels
rubrics_metrics.description: Live TV is available in the 50 United States and the District of Columbia only. Live TV is available for those live local, regional, and national channels available in your area, which are subject to change.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Enter your home ZIP code for channels available in your area. Programming subject to regional availability, blackouts and device restrictions. Certain channels or content may not be available in all locations or on all devices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Location data requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Location data required to watch certain content.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Location data may be required to watch certain content and to check channel availability in your area.

rubrics_metrics.name: Device and internet connection requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Compatible device and high-speed, broadband Internet connection required.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Multiple concurrent streams and HD content may require higher bandwidth. Streaming content may count against your data usage. Watch on your favorite devices, including TV, laptop, phone, or tablet.

rubrics_metrics.name: Content availability and rights restrictions
rubrics_metrics.description: Select content may not be available on all plans or devices; due to streaming rights, a few shows are not included in the Hulu Premium plan and will instead play interruption-free with a short ad break before and after each episode.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Programming subject to regional availability, blackouts and device restrictions. Visit the Hulu Help Center for a list of shows. Content, feature and device compatibility varies by service.

rubrics_metrics.name: Concurrent stream limits
rubrics_metrics.description: Number of permitted concurrent streams will vary based on the terms of your subscription.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Concurrent stream limits depend on the specific plan (e.g., some bundles allow streaming on 2 or 4 devices simultaneously).

rubrics_metrics.name: App-specific access and separate apps requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Subscriptions to Disney+, ESPN+, and Hulu provide access via their separate apps (or sites); download each app separately to access each service.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes access to Disney+ content and additional ESPN Unlimited content in their separate apps. Select Hulu content available via Disney+ with valid Hulu and Disney+ subscriptions; additional content only available via Hulu app. Hulu content can be streamed via Disney+ on up to 2 devices simultaneously.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pricing, promotional periods, and auto-renewal
rubrics_metrics.description: Promotional pricing applies for specified introductory periods and plans auto-renew at the then-current regular monthly price after the promotional period or free trial.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples: Hulu (With Ads) + Live TV plan $89.99/mo. after 3-day free trial (if any) unless canceled; Offer for Hulu (With Ads) + Live TV plan only: $64.99/month for 3 months, then auto-renews at then-current regular monthly price. Savings comparisons shown are compared to current regular monthly price for each service when purchased separately.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cancellation, refunds, and timing of plan switches
rubrics_metrics.description: Cancel anytime; cancellations take effect at the end of your billing period; no refunds or credits for partial months.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Switches from Live TV to Hulu take effect as of the next billing cycle. Any plan switch after redemption of this offer will result in forfeiture of the discount pricing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Non‑combinability of offers and exclusions
rubrics_metrics.description: Promotional offers are not combinable with other offers or free trials and are not redeemable via gift card.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Not combinable with any free trial or any other promotional offers or pricing (including any bundle); not redeemable via gift card. Not combinable with any free trial of the Hulu (With Ads) + Live TV plan or any other promotional offers or pricing; not redeemable via gift card.

rubrics_metrics.name: Add‑ons are extra cost
rubrics_metrics.description: Available add‑ons (HBO Max, CINEMAX, Paramount+ with SHOWTIME, STARZ, Entertainment Add-on, Sports Add-on, Español Add-on) are available for an additional cost.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Add them up after you sign up for Hulu. Examples: Entertainment Add-on $7.99/month; Español Add-on $4.99/month. Sports Add-on content includes NFL RedZone and other sports channels/features.

rubrics_metrics.name: ESPN Unlimited feature notes
rubrics_metrics.description: ESPN Unlimited includes all ESPN networks and services, including ESPN+; features and additional content/functions may be available only in the ESPN app or on ESPN.com.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ESPN Unlimited includes live events, studio shows, originals (e.g., 30 for 30). Additional features and functionalities available only in the ESPN App and on ESPN.com, and do not require purchasing through ESPN. Content subject to change; blackouts and other terms & restrictions apply.

rubrics_metrics.name: Personal, non‑commercial use; subject to agreements
rubrics_metrics.description: Services and offers are for personal and non-commercial use only and are subject to each service's Subscriber Agreement, Terms of Use, and Privacy Policy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use of Disney+, Hulu, and HBO Max are subject to their respective terms and conditions (see Disney+ Subscriber Agreement, Hulu Subscriber Agreement, HBO Max Terms of Use). For detailed information on billing and cancellation, visit the Hulu Help Center.

rubrics_metrics.name: Offer eligibility specifics and billing restrictions
rubrics_metrics.description: Some offers are available only for direct-billed purchases via Disney+, Hulu, and HBO Max and have other eligibility restrictions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: U.S. only. Must be 18+. Available only for direct-billed purchases via Disney+, Hulu, and HBO Max. Offer valid for eligible subscribers, devices, and billing partners. Select third party billed subscribers and current Disney+ and/or ESPN+ subscribers are not eligible.
